title: H3073 (123rd General Assembly): Concealed weapons; allow clerk of court to carry while on duty

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2018-12-18; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess123_2019-2020/prever/3073_20181218.htm (LegiScan doc 1831277))
provenance.note: Introduced text, Dec. 18, 2018. No votes. Struck 'and' in item (11); added '; and' in item (12).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): Notwithstanding any other provision contained in this article, the following persons who possess a valid permit pursuant to this article may carry a concealable weapon anywhere within this State, when carrying out the duties of their office:
Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): (13) clerks of court.
